name: Mirafra Software Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
india_angle: Mirafra Software Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is based in Bangalore, India, and provides semiconductor design services from this location.
summary: Mirafra Software Technologies Pvt. Ltd. offers comprehensive design services in the semiconductor industry, including RTL design, design verification, and physical design. They support end-to-end SoC chip design and have a strong presence in the automotive and CPU markets.
